info.name: SATZone API
info.description:
Production-ready SATZone backend covering Sign Up, Onboarding, Home, Explore, Course Detail, My Learnings, Degree, and Account & Settings.

**Setup**:
1. Import this collection and the `SATZone (local)` environment.
2. Select that environment (top-right).
3. Register an account via **Auth → Register** (and verify the email) — then set `user_email` / `user_password` in the environment.
4. Run **Auth → Login** — `access_token` and `refresh_token` are captured automatically.
5. All other requests inherit Bearer auth from the collection.

Default env values target the local docker-compose stack at `http://localhost:8080`.

exec: // Register no longer creates a user — verification email must be redeemed via POST /auth/verify-email.

request.description: Requires the account to have a verified phone number (set via Submit phone + Verify phone). Same response shape as /auth/login.
Bind a phone to the current user by consuming an OTP minted via /internal/phone/issue-otp (called by the Telegram bot). The phone is read out of Redis by OTP — no phone field is accepted here.

item.description: Auth-gated video playback. Lessons are HLS-only — there is no direct-MP4 endpoint, because plain MP4 over HTTP is downloadable. Tokens are bound to the requester's IP (cip claim); the same token replayed from a different network returns 401.

request.description: Multi-file companion to 'Upload lesson resource'. Adds one downloadable LessonAttachment row (PDF / slides / code zip / …) for the lesson. Use this when a lesson needs to expose more than one downloadable file. Captures `attachment_id` for the delete + 'Save attachment for offline' flows.
Remove a LessonAttachment row owned by the instructor's lesson. CASCADE cleans up any per-user 'saved for offline' rows (`user_resource_downloads`).

item.name: Assessments
item.description: Assessment authoring (instructor) and student attempts. Authoring needs an instructor token; student endpoints need an enrolled user.

item.name: Add question (multi_choice with images)
item.description: Multi-choice question. The picture-grid options reference image URLs uploaded via POST /instructor/options/{id}/image — pass that URL back in the option's image_url field, or leave blank and upload after creation.

item.name: Get assessment (student)
item.description: Caller must be enrolled in the assessment's course; options omit `is_correct`.

item.name: Get section quiz (student)
item.description: Returns the published end-of-section quiz the learner must pass to advance. 404 with section_quiz_not_found if none has been published yet.

item.name: Section quiz status (student)
item.description: Lightweight pass/attempts/score read used by the UI to unlock the next section.

item.name: Google OAuth
item.description: Backend-led Google sign-in. Open the login URL in a browser — the callback is rendered as HTML and reveals the access/refresh tokens for testing.

request.description: Returns 307 → https://accounts.google.com/... Postman won't render Google's UI; right-click the request and 'Open in Browser' to actually consent.

item.name: Notes
item.description: Per-lesson notes (My Learning → Note screens). Notes are tied to a (user, lesson) pair; the service auto-fills the course id at create time.

item.name: Downloads
item.description: Lesson resource attachments + per-user 'saved for offline' tracking (My Learning → Download). Videos are intentionally excluded — those go through /lessons/{id}/playback.

item.name: Activity
item.description: Daily activity rollups + weekly goal (Home → Set Weekly Learning Goals).

item.name: Payments
item.description: Course / program checkout. Saved cards go through Payme cards.create + cards.verify; Payme hosted checkout returns a checkout_url for redirect.

request.description: Simulates a call FROM Payme to our backend. Set payme_key in the environment to PAYME_KEY from .env.

item.name: Internal
item.description: Server-to-server endpoints used by trusted callers (Telegram bot, internal jobs). Auth is the shared `X-Internal-API-Key` header — set `internal_api_key` in the environment. Bearer auth on these requests is overridden to `noauth`.

request.description: Returns the user matching `phone_number` (E.164). 404 `user_not_found` if no match. 401 `invalid_api_key` if the header is wrong; 401 `internal_not_configured` if `INTERNAL_API_KEY` is unset on the server.

Mints an OTP for `phone_number` and stores `{otp -> phone}` in Redis (TTL = PHONE_VERIFY_EXPIRE_MINUTES). Called by the Telegram bot after the user shares their contact; the bot then shows the returned OTP to the user, who enters it on the frontend which calls `POST /auth/verify-phone`. Returns 409 `phone_taken` if the number is already verified on another account.
